title: The Argument Holds
text: The Archivist, on the relay from home, as the Lid comes up: "The last report went up with you. Planet health, every adult who said yes, Kindred, the Vell, the Choir, the Ledger, the dish on Teth. I ran it twice. It holds. If you can take that thing whole, take it whole. It's the only way anyone at Sol ever reads it."
notes: The Proof's gate (STORY.md §17), weighed at the Lantern once the Lid is open: the colony's side from the home snapshot (home planet health ≥ 70, acceptance ≥ 60, as they were when the strike force left), the rest from flags (kindred-ally, the Vell: keeper-song, the Choir: choir-fragment, ledger-read, long-ear; Engram not destroyed). Sets proof-holds, which proof and covenant-seized read as opposites, so seizing the core intact gives exactly one of them. (One event, because a trigger holds at most 8 conditions and no nested groups.)
